title: Term Life Insurance Reinstatement Amount and Restoration of Coverage
content:
## Rule

A lapsed Term Life Insurance policy with an approved reinstatement application is reinstated when the owner pays the reinstatement amount.

The reinstatement amount is fixed only after the ledger carries a billed installment for every premium due date from the paid-to date at lapse through today.

On payment the policy is shown in force again with today as its reinstatement date, its paid-to date becomes the date given, its outstanding premium becomes zero, and the reinstatement application is marked completed.

## Invocation: `pay_reinstatement_amount_3f8d4404`

**Capability.** The owner pays the reinstatement amount on a lapsed Ashgrove term policy under an approved reinstatement application. One payment of the amount given is entered on the policy's activity history against the installment due on the policy's current paid-to date; the policy is shown in force again with today as its reinstatement date, its paid-to date becomes the date given, its outstanding premium becomes zero, and the reinstatement application is marked completed.

**How it is invoked.** A customer-owned tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it to the owner, and the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `term_policy_id` — the reference number of the owner's lapsed term policy, read from the term policy lookup and given to the owner by the representative; identifier, as recorded.
- `term_request_id` — the reference number of the approved reinstatement application, read from the service request lookup and given to the owner by the representative; identifier, as recorded.
- `reinstatement_amount` — the amount the owner pays; USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places (the tool rounds half to even to the cent if more are given).
- `payment_method` — how the owner pays, one of: `eft` (a one-time draft from the owner's bank account), `check` (a mailed paper check), `debit_card` (a debit card payment taken over the telephone), `online_bank_payment` (a payment the owner sends from the bank's online bill pay).
- `new_paid_to_date` — the paid-to date the policy carries once the payment is applied, as YYYY-MM-DD.

**Return.** The owner sees a confirmation with `status` ("policy_reinstated" on success), `payment_id` (the reference number of the new payment entry), `term_policy_id`, `term_request_id`, `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `reinstatement_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today), `paid_to_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `policy_status` (always "in_force").
